section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a Latent Inhibition (LI) task, which involved two conditions: preexposed and nonpreexposed. Participants in the preexposed condition were exposed to nonsense syllables and white noise bursts, while those in the nonpreexposed condition were not exposed to the target stimulus during the preexposure phase. The task measured the number of trials required for participants to identify a rule, with lower scores in the preexposed condition indicating attenuated LI.
